github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Follow Conventional Commits, validated by commitlint (@commitlint/config-conventional). Write in English.
Header format: '<type>: <subject>' or '<type>(<scope>): <subject>'. Max 72 characters. Lowercase type, imperative mood ('add', not 'added'), no trailing period.
Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert.

Choosing the type: 'feat' ONLY for new user-facing website functionality and 'fix' ONLY for user-facing bug fixes. Tooling, config, dependencies, git hooks, editor settings, linting and formatting setup are 'chore' (or 'build' for build/bundler changes, 'ci' for GitHub Actions). Tests are 'test', README/docs are 'docs'.
Body is optional. If present: one blank line after the header, short bullet points starting with '- ', and EVERY body line must be at most 100 characters; wrap longer bullets onto the next line.
